values: How to Use This Vehicle Quotation Template
Confirm buyer company, destination port, and final destination.
Foreign buyers usually compare offers by landed cost and delivery route.
Select Incoterms clearly: FOB, CFR, CIF, DAP, or DDP.
This avoids misunderstanding about shipping, insurance, tax, and local clearance.
Separate vehicle price, freight, insurance, and other charges.
International buyers prefer transparent price breakdowns.
Specify model year, trim, fuel type, drive type, color, and lead time.
Vehicle specs affect compliance, resale value, and buyer approval.
Attach photos, VIN or stock confirmation only after final stock is confirmed.
This keeps the quotation professional and avoids overpromising.
Send the quotation as PDF after checking all editable fields.
PDF is easier for customers to review and forward internally.
Issue a Proforma Invoice only after the buyer confirms the quotation.
The PI should match the final payment, shipment, and document terms.
This quotation is valid for 14 days from the quotation date.
Vehicle availability is subject to final stock confirmation.
Prices may change due to exchange rate, factory policy, shipping cost, or market conditions.
30% deposit is required to reserve the vehicle. Balance payment shall be made before shipment.
Shipping schedule is subject to carrier space and destination port conditions.
Standard export documents will be provided after shipment.
Third-party inspection can be arranged at buyer's cost if required.
Warranty terms depend on manufacturer policy and destination market regulations.
Please confirm the model, quantity, color, destination port, and preferred Incoterms.
